preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reference_books WHERE code = 'kitchen_departments'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO reference_books (code, name, description, active) VALUES ('kitchen_departments', 'Цеха кухни', 'Горячий, холодный, бар и др.', TRUE);
INSERT INTO reference_book_entries (reference_book_id, value, label, sort_order) SELECT rb.id, v.value, v.label, v.sort_order FROM reference_books rb CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('HOT', 'Горячий цех', 10), ('COLD', 'Холодный цех', 20), ('BAR', 'Бар', 30), ('GRILL', 'Гриль', 40), ('PASTRY', 'Кондитерский', 50) ) AS v(value, label, sort_order) WHERE rb.code = 'kitchen_departments';

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_type_fields f JOIN business_types bt ON bt.id = f.business_type_id WHERE bt.code = 'RESTAURANT' AND f.field_key = 'preparation_time_min'

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO business_type_fields (business_type_id, field_key, label, field_type, required, sort_order) SELECT bt.id, v.field_key, v.label, v.field_type, v.required, v.sort_order FROM business_types bt CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('preparation_time_min', 'Время приготовления, мин', 'NUMBER', FALSE, 10), ('kitchen_department', 'Цех', 'LIST', FALSE, 20), ('combo_component', 'Компонент комбо', 'BOOLEAN', FALSE, 30) ) AS v(field_key, label, field_type, required, sort_order) WHERE bt.code IN ('RESTAURANT', 'CANTEEN') ON CONFLICT (business_type_id, field_key) DO NOTHING;
UPDATE business_type_fields f SET reference_book_id = rb.id FROM business_types bt JOIN reference_books rb ON rb.code = 'kitchen_departments' WHERE f.business_type_id = bt.id AND bt.code IN ('RESTAURANT', 'CANTEEN') AND f.field_key = 'kitchen_department';
